title: Ordinary constant/completed balancing respects scalar associativity
statement: For finite l-adic coefficient extensions E to F to L, every scheme W and every completed integral E-module sheaf M, ordinary scalar balancing commutes with the ordinary associators determined by the composite unit-normalized scalar adjunctions and identity-on-sections restriction compositors.

source.place: Tag 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), Tag 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change); ordinary tensor associativity: sites-modules.tex, Tag 03EK.

proof.text: Transpose both sides twice along the ordinary constant scalar adjunctions. Hom adjunctions are injective. Equality of their transposes is checked on arbitrary local sections x. The adjunction unit sends x to 1 tensor x. Its naturality moves the first balancing through the second extension. Each balancing sends the constant tensor unit to the completed tensor unit by its prescribed pure-tensor formula at scalar 1. The left-adjoint-uniqueness associator sends successive units to the direct unit, because the restriction compositor is the identity on sections. Thus both transposes send x to the same direct completed tensor unit. The argument applies to zero modules, empty sites and identity embeddings.

theorem scalarCompletionOrdinary_composition
    (M : scalarReductionSource l E W) :
    (pbcExtend (constantMap l F L j W)).map
        ((scalarCompletionOrdinary l E F i W).hom.app M) ≫
      (scalarCompletionOrdinary l F L j W).hom.app
        ((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)).obj M) ≫
      (constantRestriction l L W).map
        ((ordinaryScalarAssociator _ _ _
          (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E F i L j W)).hom.app M) =
    (ordinaryScalarAssociator _ _ _ (by
      unfold constantMap
      rw [← Functor.map_comp]
      congr 1)).hom.app ((constantRestriction l E W).obj M) ≫
      (scalarCompletionOrdinary l E L (j.comp i) W).hom.app M
